svg.text: OXYGEN · DFM.4.3 · UI ARTWORK BOARD · OWNER APPROVED · 2026-11-01
Clean forecast first. Diagnostics only when invited.
Same immersive scene and time tape; the debug overlay adds labeled source evidence without changing the forecast readout.
Place, refresh, atmosphere and tape remain.
No status row, dataset control, or diagnostics.
Debug controls stay off the forecast
Place + refresh and the responsive time tape remain.
Sun/moon stays scene art; no diagnostic overlay.
Diagnostic panels stay in the upper sky
Choose groups · save a local display preset
Preset choice stays separate from overlay visibility.
The active overlay is opt-in and follows the selected time.
04 · CONFIGURE A LOCAL DISPLAY PRESET · DEBUG MENU STATE
Save groups only · no forecast or source changes
Keep source details reachable from the time tape
Existing “Browse forecast values” retains source, product, freshness/stale, offline and error details.
Browsing does not change time; selecting a row keeps existing navigation behavior.
Artwork proposal only. Installed captures and scoped interactions are still required for acceptance.
Catalog editor/storage and release integration remain separate DFM.4 slices.
Reference boards: DFM.4 session flow · normal/debug overlay · catalog picker. Scene is schematic; installed artwork remains unchanged. Baseline capture is in cycle evidence.
